observability_triage.rationale: The requirement is electrically deterministic, but the current KiCad parser exposes only reference lists, footprint library names, net names, and outline lines. It cannot associate switches/buttons with footprints and nets, so it cannot prove that BOOT is the only directly mounted button and all panel controls use connectors.
repair_requirements: Parse symbol values and footprint references
Parse pad-to-net membership and connector pin maps
Expose board-side placement for directly mounted controls

evidence: parse_artifacts returns component reference strings but not symbol values or component-pin mappings
Footprint output is not associated with component roles or nets
missing_observables: BOOT button footprint and board placement
Panel button connector footprints and pin nets
Absence of any other directly mounted button
minimum_environment_repairs: Add real switch/button/connector symbols and footprints to the generated KiCad files
Extend the parser to return reference, value, footprint, position, and pad-net membership
blocker_or_exclusion.reentry_condition: Re-author after the parsed KiCad artifact can identify every button and connector and relate each pad to its net.

uncovered_items.evidence: Current parser output cannot distinguish directly mounted controls from connector-mediated panel controls.
uncovered_items.required_action: Repair KiCad generation and parsing before validator authoring.
